lead: # The gate writes its verdict to target/gate-result.json; `promote` reads it to decide whether every
# red leg is a DECLARED known-red. An unreadable verdict must read as ABSENT, never as a pass.
# `bsc-app` — the APP's own lifecycle: is the running binary current, may develop be promoted into
# it, rebuild it from cold, cut a release, install the hooks.
# A LEAN, standalone crate (like `bsc-self`): the shared CLI scaffold, JSON for the gate verdict, and
# nothing else. No Tauri, no database — so it stays out of the DuckDB build path and a scoped
# `cargo check -p bsc-app` is seconds rather than minutes.
